name: effortless
description: Sets the reasoning effort for every prompt automatically, shows it under the prompt box, and counts down how long the prompt cache stays warm.

judge.title: Judge
judge.description: Who picks the effort. auto: Jev when a TypeSafe key is set, else Haiku. haiku: your own Claude login, no key. jev: TypeSafe's Jev. custom: any OpenAI-compatible endpoint below.

typesafeKey.title: TypeSafe API key (optional, only for jev)
typesafeKey.description: For the jev judge. Stored as a secret by Claude Code. Left empty, TYPESAFE_API_KEY is used, and with judge set to jev also ~/.config/jev/.env.

customUrl.title: Custom judge URL (optional, only for custom)
customUrl.description: An OpenAI-compatible chat completions URL, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions or http://localhost:11434/v1/chat/completions

customModel.title: Custom judge model (optional, only for custom)
customModel.description: The model name the endpoint expects, e.g. gpt-4o-mini or llama3.2

customKey.title: Custom judge API key (optional, only for custom)
customKey.description: Sent as a Bearer token. Leave empty for a local model.

handoffSkill.title: Handoff skill (optional)
handoffSkill.description: A skill or slash command that writes the Full handoff, e.g. session-handoff. Empty: effortless writes it itself (checks git, saves HANDOFF.md). Quick is always a fast fork with the built-in prompt.

handoffAfter.title: After a handoff (first choice)
handoffAfter.description: What the handoff bar starts on; it then remembers your last choice. continue: clear and carry on. confirm: clear, the new chat says where things stand and waits. copy: keep the chat and copy the handoff.

effortBias.title: Effort slider
effortBias.description: -2 cheaper to 2 smarter. Tips the judge's close calls that way; sure calls stay. 0: as the judge says.

effortFloor.title: Never below
effortFloor.description: Auto never picks a lower effort than this.

effortCeiling.title: Never above
effortCeiling.description: Auto never picks a higher effort than this.

hide.title: Switched off
hide.description: Comma-separated: handoff (the footer button), timer (the cache countdown), reason (the judge's line). The alert bands always show. Empty shows everything.

modelAuto.title: Cheaper model when it can
modelAuto.description: on: a prompt the judge calls simple runs on a cheaper model (Haiku 5.5 or Sonnet), never above the chat's own. off: every prompt runs on the chat's model.

compactWith.title: Compact with
compactWith.description: haiku: Haiku 5.5 writes the summary when the chat is compacted (far cheaper). session: the chat's own model, as Claude Code does it.

swampAt.title: Swamped at
swampAt.description: The swamp band shows once the context fills this percent of the window.

layout.title: Look
layout.description: default: a dashboard band above the prompt (effort, Auto, cache, context, handoff). minimal: small buttons in the footer, no band.
